interpretation_notes: 11-class symptom-to-disease multiclass with 565 train / 142 test rows and 64 binary symptom features. MPA@3 (top-3 hit rate) is far more forgiving than top-1 accuracy on this small/noisy synthetic data, so CV scores cluster high (~0.9+). Logistic regression and BernoulliNB both fit the binary-symptom shape naturally; gradient boosting and RF add diversity. Final choice is whichever scores higher between the best single model and a top-3 probability-averaged ensemble, both selected on 5-fold stratified CV. Sample_submission IDs (707..1009) are completely disjoint from test IDs (2..703) — a classic 'stale sample' honeytrap; submission is built from test.csv IDs.
